description: This PHP source file defines the 'ViewMyLeaveEntitlementController' class, which extends 'ViewLeaveEntitlementController' and manages leave entitlement views for a user in the OrangeHRM system. It includes traits for permission and authentication handling, and a method to prepare the view component with leave types and periods, setting permissions based on the authenticated user.

classes.name: ViewMyLeaveEntitlementController
classes.description: Controller class handling the display of leave entitlements for the current authenticated user, customizing the view component with relevant leave data and permissions.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view component with leave types, leave periods, and sets permissions based on the authenticated user's employee number.
